headline: Target Shares Rally on Earnings Beat as Analysts Lift Price Targets - The Bull
summary: Target shares were at $126.15 after a 3.12% gain, extending a post-earnings rally as Wall Street analysts raised price targets. The stock is up 25% this year.
why: Target is a large US general merchandise retailer, and its results are read as a barometer of US consumer spending.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.
